counter_definitions.bytes_received: Bytes delivered by completed host-side receive descriptors, including PJL envelope bytes.
counter_definitions.parser_errors: Invalid or truncated framing incidents; semantic print validation is intentionally out of scope.
counter_definitions.receive_descriptors_completed: Every feed_descriptor call, including a zero-byte completion.
counter_definitions.recognized_chunks: Completely received chunks whose type is in the controlled-sample probe scope 0x00..0x06.
counter_definitions.unknown_chunks: Completely received chunks outside the narrow probe scope, skipped without error.

format_contract.malformed_policy: increment parser_errors, abort the active document, and scan for the next JZJZ
format_contract.unknown_type_policy: count and skip a completely framed chunk; do not increment parser_errors
format_contract.zero_length_distinction: a 16-byte chunk with zero payload is valid; a declared total size below 16 is malformed
